surfaces: ee context (soft-deprecated alias, same hydration lane)

trigger.description: Live imported-evidence hydration or incident-card verification could not be completed normally. Missing, malformed, denied, or unreadable source rows are excluded; failed incident-card lookups retain original transcript candidates. Native evidence does not require distillation into a memory. The batch-failure case covered here reports fallback to individual source reads: readable, admitted evidence survives with the same content and provenance, and denied evidence stays excluded. Its diagnostic is stable and excludes raw database errors.
setup_commands: # Regression-only fault: make the recorded-verdict lookup fail in a disposable store while keeping evidence and session rows readable.
# Executable regression: scripts/rch_verify.sh --pinned-franken-stack --treeish HEAD -- cargo test --locked --lib direct_evidence_batch_failure_reports_fallback_and_preserves_admission
trigger.invocation: ee pack "<unique transcript phrase from the imported session>" --workspace . --json
